title: EG&G as gatekeeper of Area 51
place_text: Area 51 / Groom Lake, Nevada; Las Vegas

tellings.quote: Area 51. In the early 1960s, EGNG's special projects division based in Las Vegas had been trusted to handle personnel screening, site access, transportation, and daily operations.

plain: In the early 1960s, a company called EG&G, through a special projects division based in Las Vegas, was trusted to run the day-to-day business of Area 51, a secret military test site at Groom Lake in Nevada. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and says the company handled screening of staff, access to the site, transport and daily operations. If true, a private contractor was the gatekeeper of one of the most secret places in the country.
